subject: Archer: minimal evidence onboarding & air-gap proofflow
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlantech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Archer onboarding — minimal proof for air‑gapped deployment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We are starting the Archer onboarding for Atlantech and have a constrained scope: the customer will run a partially air‑gapped deployment (no direct outbound S3 uploads allowed from the environment). They asked whether Redwood can provide a "minimal proofflow" for SOC2/CAIQ items that we can attach to the Archer profile without exposing internal S3 buckets.

Specifically Atlantech needs:
- a signed manifest of possession for a handful of documents (SOC2 reports, KMS rotation logs)
- screenshots or signed hashes for key KMS metadata (rotation timestamps, key IDs)
- a short bridge runbook describing how evidence is transferred via an approved jump-host process

I can invite your account to Archer if you confirm a single point of contact and preferred evidence filenames. Portal link will be handy: https://archer.vendorportal.com/invite/AB12CD34

Can you confirm by EOD Monday whether Kimberly or someone on her team will upload a compressed evidence bundle, or whether Atlantech needs us to host an escrow snapshot to their vendor console?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Security Manager, Atlantech
security@atlantech.com

--
Attachment: initial-evidence-ask.pdf (PDF stub, 48KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlantech.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — minimal proof for air‑gapped deployment

Thanks Emily — looping in Marissa (evidence coordination) and Rishi (platform infra) to scope how we can produce a minimal, verifiable bundle that satisfies Atlantech without exposing internal S3.

Marissa / Rishi — quick asks to scope: several small items we typically provide:
1) evidence-manifest.csv (list of docs + SHA256)
2) PDF/PNG snapshots of KMS console showing rotation timestamps + KID
3) bridge-runbook.pdf (1‑2 pages) explaining transfer steps and jump‑host checks

Constraints: Atlantech will not accept direct presigned S3 links from our production bucket. They prefer either (A) signed manifest + hash-only artifacts uploaded directly to Archer, or (B) an escrow snapshot hosted on Atlantech-approved object storage (we can stage to a short-lived, auditor-only bucket and record the hash).

Emily — is option A acceptable? If so we will prepare a zipped bundle with hashed files and a signed manifest (PGP signature from Redwood Compliance).

I plan to put owners and deadlines below and attach a manifest template.

Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: manifest-template.csv (CSV stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlantech.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Nov 2028 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — minimal proof for air‑gapped deployment

Got it. I can assemble the bundle — here's the plan:

Owners & timeline
- Marissa: evidence-manifest.csv + bridge-runbook.pdf (draft by Mon 11/6)
- Rishi: export of KMS metadata + screenshots (Mon 11/6), will include rotation timestamps and key IDs. I will redact internal account numbers and include only KID/hash and rotation ISO times.
- Kimberly: PGP signature of the manifest and final approval (Tue 11/7)

Delivery approach — choose Option A (hash-only upload to Archer):
- We'll create a zip with the files, produce SHA256 for each file and include those in evidence-manifest.csv.
- I'll attach a short note in Archer describing our transfer model (bridge-runbook.pdf).
- We'll generate PGP-signed manifest (signed-manifest.asc) and include signed-manifest.asc in the upload.

Attachments I'm prepping: evidence-manifest.csv, kms-rotation-screenshot.png (sensitive fields redacted), bridge-runbook.pdf, signed-manifest.asc

Emily — please confirm Archer will accept a signed manifest + file hashes in place of direct file possession proofs for the initial onboarding. If they need a short-lived escrow bucket, we'll pivot, but prefer hash-first approach to avoid cross-account uploads.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: evidence-manifest.csv, kms-rotation-screenshot.png

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlantech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Nov 2028 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding — minimal evidence onboarding & air‑gap proofflow

Thanks Marissa — option A is fine for Atlantech as long as the manifest is signed and hashes are present. We will accept the signed-manifest.asc and the CSV with SHA256 entries in Archer. For the KMS screenshots please ensure any usernames or account numbers are redacted; timestamps and KID visible.

I'll send the Archer invite to the kimberly.park@redwood.ai account after your draft is uploaded. Portal link: https://archer.vendorportal.com/invite/AB12CD34

Emily
